name: jev-cua
description: Guarded general Mac computer use with consented screenshots, opaque visual targeting, verified actions, and deterministic fast paths.

interface.shortDescription: Guarded general Mac control with verified actions.
interface.longDescription: Provides app-agnostic Mac computer use through exact app launch, Accessibility controls, consented in-memory screenshots, opaque two-stage visual targeting when the result remains semantically verifiable, non-secret text entry, keys, menus, and scrolling. Raw coordinates, PIDs, native refs, executable menu paths, arbitrary hotkeys, force quit, power/session actions, and secret entry stay unavailable. Every mutation is rebound against fresh state, durably at-most-once, and must satisfy an explicit postcondition; consequential actions use one-shot approval. Reviewed repetitive browser workflows add deterministic fast paths, while optional TypeSafe Jev routing only recommends among installed workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use Jev Cua to operate this Mac app and verify each change.
Launch this app and complete the task through general Mac computer use.
Use visual targeting for a control Accessibility cannot identify when its intended result is still semantically verifiable.
Inspect this app and show me its available bound actions and approval requirements.
Run this reviewed browser workflow through the compiled fast path.
Recommend the installed workflow that matches this request.
Check whether Jev Cua is ready on this Mac.
